balls.text: Rajasthan bowled out for 159.  Really full delivery on the leg stump line, the bat is late in coming down and the ball goes on to claim the leg stump
full delivery outside off , goes for the big off drive and ends up slicing it over short third man!
full pitched around off, edges the off drive to short fine-leg
full pitched on the leg stump line, whipped away to the on side
mistimes the pull shot towards long-on and it drops safely
moves outside leg stump and crashes the full delivery to cover point boundary
short in length outside off, tries to cut to third man but makes no contact
moves outside leg and drives straight to Ojha at mid-off
pushes it down the leg side. Gilly is slightly slow in getting across and doesn't collect cleanly
full in length, slower one, outside off, scooped out towards short cover where Symonds dives forward to take a good catch
serves a short delivery which has been pulled by Aditya to the backward square-leg boundary
full in length, pushed out to mid-off
130 kmph bouncer and Gilly collects
slow bouncer outside off stump, left alone
Warne is run out. It was pushed towards backward point where RP fires in a direct hit at the striker's end
slower one from round the stumps, Morne has a big swing but misses. . the ball tails past the leg stump
pushes this one to covers
outside off stump, chopped away to backward point boundary.
Almost another wicket for RP. Warne tries to dab a length delivery to the on side and gets a leading edge .. the ball spoons up say to short mid-off region but falls safely
length delivery on the off stump line, Warne, who has been pretty awful with the bat so far, has a lame poke at it and is beaten
the slower bouncer, around 115 kmph, Watson mistimes his pull shot to deep  square-leg. Watson falls after an entertaining fifty. He did give a few chances, though.
short delivery and Watson fetches it from outside off stump and crashes it to left of deep midwicket where Dwayne SMith seemed to have covered it but ends up pushing it to the boundary
almost caught at backward point by ROhit. The batsman edges the off drive and it flies low to left of Rohit ..
outside off stump, chopped away
another slower one, jabbed out to the on side
Done in by another slower one. Double strike.  Raut goes down on his knee and tries to pull it away but is beaten by the lack of pace. Trapped in front.
slower one outside off stump, beaten, trying to push it to the third -man region
leans forward to drive to the off side where Rohit gets across from covers and dives but misses. Symonds dives to his left at mid-on to stop it ..
length delivery, slower one outside off, Jhunjhunwala reaches out and cuts it to gully.
slower one, full toss on the leg stump, Watson misses out as he drags it to deep square-leg fielder
low full toss outside leg stump, wide
full in length, around off stump line, driven wide of sweeper cover
length delivery around off, pushed down to long-off
almost yorker length outside off stump, dug out to the off-side of the pitch
full in length around off stump, pushed out to cover
short in length, heaved through the on side
short in length outside off, cut to deep point
worked to midwicket region
almost caught at long-off. It was lifted towards the boundary where Symonds leaps but ends up palming it over. Fab effort from Symonds who tried his best but couldn't hold on ..
works this to left of deep cover for a single
leans forward to tap it past square-leg ..
leans forward to heave the delivery from the off stump line to long-on
gets forward to turn it to the on side
starts the over with a wide
jabbed away to the off side
edged but just wide of the diving Gilly. It was a sharp lifting delivery around off, stabbed to right of Gilchrist who dives but cant' reach it
Short ball gets Yusuf. Again. He moved outside leg, Harris follows him with a short ball, not a bouncer but dug in short, and Yusuf shovels it to backward point.
lifting delivery on the middle stump, Yusuf stabs it to the on side .. bit unconvincingly
on the middle stump line, pushed to the on side
short in length, on the middle and leg, worked past square-leg
length delivery just outside off, pushed to left of mid-off
slower one, mistimes the heave to mid-on
full in length, dragged past square-leg for two runs
length delivery around off, punched away to the off side
cuts in towards middle, tapped to midwicket .. no one there .. by the time the man rushes in from the deep they take two runs
the slow bouncer outside off stump, Yusuf tries to upper cut it but makes no contact
holes out to deep midwicket. Fazal was looking for some quick runs here;' he again moved down the track but ended up dragging the ball straight to deep midwicket
moves down the track and lofts it well to the right of long-on fielder
goes for the reverse sweep, misses and it goes just down the leg side ... Gilchrist doesn't come across. mistake from him
skips down the track, Ojha had slowed up the pace and floated it outside off, Fazal adjusts and plays a neat square drive to point boundary
stays back to force this to long-on
goes down the track and drags it to deep midwicket
pushed through the on side for a single

run out chance missed. It was pushed towards backward point .. Azhar bilakhia hurls the throw to Symonds .. awkward bounce and he doesn't collect it cleanly and breaks the stumps with his hands. Look pa no ball!
yet another slower one, a ugly heave from Watto gets the ball down to long-on
goes down the track and heaves it down to long-on
on the leg stump line, slower one, pushed towards mid-off
around off stump line, driven wide of long-off
low full toss, punched away to left of long-on for couple of runs
short in length outside off stump, punched to wide third man
heaves this one towards long-on .. mistimes it
overpitched outside off stump, hit-me ball, and Watson crashes it to cover point boundary
around off stump line, tapped to short third man
length delivery around 133 kmph, on the middle, tucked towards square-leg
slows up the pace finally, around off stump, turning away, forced to long-on
another shortish delivery, he is bowling the same delivery to Watto who this time finds the gap between deep midwicket and long-on. Fiercely pulled.
around the off stump line, pushed to short third man ...
shortish again, another one going on with the arm, pulled to deep midwicket
driven through the on side
quickish, short-of-length delivery on the middle stump but Fazal plays a nice little paddle shot to backward square-leg boundary. Nice little swat
full in length, swung to deep midwicket
leans forward to defend to cover
full in length, around the middle, driven to long-on
really full in length, driven to long-on where RP makes a mess of a regulation stop. Gilchrist has a few words to say to his team-mate
leans across to drive to cover point
short in length, goes for the pull and doesn't connect
leans across to drive to cover
Delicious wallop. Watson heaves his big frame forward and blasts this length delivery over long-on
Dropped by Mr Harris Oh well. Much fun. It was pulled to him at deep midwicket where he makes a complete mess. Clanger!
slower one, just outside off stump, Watson chops it again straight to that wide slip/gully fielder. Hmmm
full in length, worked through midwicket
on the off stump line, tilting away, run down wide of third man for couple of runs
short and wide outside off stump, watson goes for a cut but doesn't connect.
again he tries to chop to third man, again no room, he gets it to wide slip/gully
in the zone outside off stump, Watson tries to late cut but can't get bat to ball
around 110 kmph, short delivery, pulled away to deep midwicket
outside off stump, dabbed to third man
in the channel outside off stump, Fazal is beaten, pushing inside the line
Crashed. Another bit of rubbish. Short, around 125 kmph, sits up and pleads with Watto to be hit. And he obliges. He pulls it over midwicket. Thank you. Come again.
tries to shuffle across and work it to the on side and the ball rolls of the pad to the off side
just outside off, worked to mid-on
another slower one but shot and wide, bit of rubbish really, and Fazal crashes it to the point boundary
gets forward to push it to cover
starts off with a slower one, fullish, pushed to mid-on .. overthrows at the non-striker's end ...waste of a run
length delivery drifting to the leg stump line and it moves past the attempted leg glance but runs off the pad to the fine-leg boundary.
chopped to thirdman for a single
around the off-stump line, defended on the front foot
RP and Harris combo at it again. It was pushed well outside off stump, Ojha plays a weak slash. And the ball gently lobs to cover where Harris - oh he is everywhere isn't he - takes it
shuffles across to the off stump, RP straightens it around off stump line, Ojha is cramped for room as he attempts to chop it away. The ball brushes the pad en route to GIlly
RP serves this wide outside off stump.

And as it happens in cricket, its Harris who takes the catch. A length delivery outside leg stump was slogged towards deep midwicket. The ball dips right near the boundary and who else but Harris should settle under it
And again. He doesn't quite stay still. Neither does he move forward quickly. he almost stumbles out at the last minute and as a result makes no contact with the attempted on-the-up hit
swing and a miss outside off stump, Gilchrist collects.
back of length, angling away, run down to third man
Thrash. He just cleared the front leg and smashed this length delivery over mid-on.
Edged past first slip. It was a length delivery that was angling away from Lumb, who tries to drive on the up through covers, and it flashes past Laxman
length delivery on the middle stump line, turned to the midwicket region
Whack! Lumb finishes the over of drama with a wallop. He charged out, moved outside leg, and slammed a length delivery over long-off
around the off stump, pushed away to the off side

Drama A catch has been deemed illegal.  Almost comedy of errors but Harris holds on after a juggle. Or does he? No says the third umpire.  It was a back-of-length delivery which lumb pushes tamely back to Harris. It's chest-high. Harris palms it ,, the ball bounds to his thighs and pops up.. Harris grabs at it again and the ball is between his wrists as he goes down to the ground. He just about lifts his hands but again presses it back down on the ground. The ball has, or so it appears on tv, touched the ground. The batsman had walked off but he is then called back .
around 132 kmph length delivery, outside off stump and it just about straightened. Lumb pushes outside the line and is beaten
again driven out to cover. Shane Warne chose to bat
length delivery, around the off stump, gentle loosener, pushed out to covers

OMG! what a win for Warney's boys. What a piece of choke from  Deccan. Sid Trivedi slips in a slower one outside off and Rohit goes for the big lofted hit over extra cover and is beaten by the lack of pace. He ends up slicing it to deep cover fielder. That Trivedi bowls mostly slower ones is known. Rohit should have been ready for it but the pressure has induced a fatal mistake from him.

Choke choke choke! What  drama! Harmeet is run out This game is on a knife edge and nerves jangling out there. ROhit swatted a low dipping full toss to square-leg and ran. Wide throw at the non-striker's end ... Rohit rushes for the second run ... Harmeet isn't ready! Surely you got to run kid. Rohit screams at Harmeet to get across and sacrifice his wicket. And Harmeet just about stirs and runs .. Did he cross? Was Rohit short? The third umpire reckons Harmeet has just about crossed Rohit. Harmeet out and Rohit is still out there.

What a catch by Morne! RP went for the big hit again and mistimed the slower one over mid-on. Morne rushed back and took a very good catch . the ball came from behind him, he stretched out his hands to hold on .. Rohit on strike now.
Almost bowled! Much fun. What a slog attempted! RP rushes down the track and has a ugly swipe. It was the slower one and it gently goes just over the middle stump!
high slow bouncer but sails high over the batsman. Wide. Warne doesn't like it, has a chat with the umpire. But it did go well high over RP
the slow bouncer, dragged down to deep square-leg. Warne brings his men up.
short delivery this time, pulled to deep midwicket . slight fumble there .. Rohit sets out for the second run but RP says hold on you stay there and take strike next over
Is this is the shot that wins the game for Deccan? The game-breaker shot?. Full pitched delivery, straight and Rohit flays it right over the straight boundary. Warne screams in agony!
Big swing and a miss. It kicked up from short of length and straightened just outside off, ROhit went for the big swing and it missed the off stump
moves outside leg stump, exposes all his stumps, its a full delivery, RP goes for a slog and edges it to right of mid-on. Hmmm
picks a single with a dab to third man. Morne now gets to bowl at RP
Flat-batted forehand down the line .. ala Manish Pandey. IT was a short delivery outside off and Rohit flat bats it between the bowler and mid-off
Just a slip in. RP tries to jump down the track (why?!) and manages to get some bat on it .. the ball rolls to cover
flighted on leg and middle, slip and silly point in, scooped through midwicket

Shane Warne is doing all the damage here. What Harris was doing, we would never know. He came down the wicket and exposed his stumps. Warne rips across a flighted legbreak that lands outside leg and turns towards middle. Harris has a lame poke at it and misses it completely.. Done in the flight and then by the turn! Clatter! Warne has struck. Again. Whaddaplayaaaa
on the middle stump , slightly quicker, skidding on, pushed out to long-off
on the middle and off line, slightly short, cut to sweeper cover

Warne meanwhile threatens to do it all alone for his team. Flighted loopy slower leg break around off and middle, Azhar stretches forward and drives straight to extra cover! Warne pumps his fists as he roars! Rohit stands alone there.
What a over for Deccan. Splendid stuff from Rohit. Full pitched delivery outside off and he unfurls a fine square-drive
He picks the slower one and plays a neat pick-up shot over wide midwicket. Ala Carl Hooper.

Fab shot. He moves outside off stump and flashes the length delivery to backward point boundary. 50 up. Fine innings under pressure. Fourth batsman after Gilly, Raina and Hayden to cross 1000 IPL runs
slower one, Rohit was shuffling across, stops his movement and defends to the off side
full in length outside off, driven to right of sweeper cover for couple of runs
cuts in from just outside off, full in length, edged to short fine-leg region
dipping flighted delivery, lovely stuff, pushed out to midwicket
turns from the middle and leg line, towards off, Azhar is almost squared-up, jabbed to the off side
slightly short, cut away to sweeper cover
"C'monn," screams Warney! after taking out Smith. It was a flighted leg break on the middle and leg, Smith top edges the sweep shot straight to deep backward square-leg. Warne roars!
turns from middle stump iine, pushed back to the bowler
flighted legbreak on the off stump line, Smith  tries to wrist it to the on side and gets a leading edge over extra cover!
full in length, on middle and leg, turned behind square-leg
slower one, fullish, pushed out back to Watson. Warne has a word with his bowler
digs it in short, pulled away to deep midwicket
full pitched outside off stump, driven to left of deep cover
slower one outside off stump, guided to backward point
driven to left of mid-off for a single
slip in place. .. lovely leg break from middle and leg, Smith pushes at it, clueless, and the ball spins past the outside edge. Warne holds his head! .. Naman Ojha doesn't collect it cleanly

Done in by the slider. It slid away outside off stump, Aniruddh tried to punch it to the off side and edges it  .. good catch by Naman Ojha ... it was thick edge but he covered it well. Warne has struck. Enter Dwayne Smith
lovely flighted delivery outside off, Anirudh lunges out to cover drive and edges it to the pad
slows up the pace, fuller, tapped to point
drops it short and Anirudh pulls it to midwicket boundary
turns in to hit the pad, going down the leg side
goes for yet another slower one, Rohit is ready, picks it up early and lofts it over mid-off
slower one again, full in length, pushed past point
slower one outside off, tapped to point
on the middle stump line, clipped through midwicket
bangs it in short, pulled down to deep backward square-leg region
quicker one, skids on, pushed back to Warne
drops it short and Rohit plays a nonchalant pull shot over square-leg boundary. Thrash.
backs away slightly to punch to cover
turns in slowly to the middle stump line, tucked behind square leg
leg break on the off and middle line, worked to the on side
moves down the leg side, Trivedi slips in a 121 kmph bouncer and Rohit steers it over backward point
length delivery outside off, punched through covers
fullish, on the off and middle, slower one, worked wide of mid-on
lifting delivery around off, pushed down to the off side
turns this length delivery to midwicket
Done in by the slow bouncer. Symonds, who has looked edgy right from the start, is gone. He again moved outside off and went for an ugly flat-batted swipe and top edges it to extra cover
backs away to the leg side, length delivery just outside off stump, flashed away to wide third-man boundary
short in length outside off, run down to right of third man
length delivery cuts back in from outside off, tapped to backward point
backs away to thrash a short delivery to point boundary. Whack!
And again. Symonds tries to run it down to third man and is beaten again
full in length and in the channel outside off, Symonds has a lame poke and is beaten
full in length outside off stump, driven to left of deep cover
banged in short and Rohit pulls it down to deep backward square-leg region
again slips down the leg side, slightly short, ROhit laps it around the corner to the fine-leg boundary. Neatly done.
dug in short, pulled to right of deep square-leg
on the leg stump line, runs away off the pad down to fine-leg
shortish, on the off stump line, Rohit sharma goes for the pull and top edges it over mid-on ...
slower one, fuller, turned behind square-leg
backs away and flat bats a short delivery uppishly towards deep cover
slower one outside off stump, run down to third man
cuts in from outside off, dabbed to gully region
just outside off stump, run down to third man
goes for another big shot, again doesn't connect all that well.. he moves outside off and slices the full delivery almost straight to deep cover
short in length on the middle, turned to fine-leg
lifting delivery outside off stump, Symonds allows it to pass over him
short in length on the middle stump line, tucked behind square-leg
just outside off stump, tapping to third man
Another high-risk shot attempted by Symonds. He goes for a pull shot to a delivery outside off and doesn't connect
length delivery on middle, clipped past square-leg
length delivery that straightens around off and middle, pushed out to the off side
outside off stump line, left alone ..
full in length, on the middle and off, defended carefully back to the bowler
Morne falls to the ground after releasing the delivery. It was a bouncing delivery outside off, flies past the attempted cut
backs away again and goes for the expansive cut shot but fails to connect.
moves outside leg, Morne follows him and the ball goes between Symonds and leg stump
Superb upper cut. Banged in short outside off, Symonds opens the bat-face and flashes it up and over.
Almost dragged on! Short in length outside off stump, Symonds edges the defensive push just past the off stump
Gilly out on dole! It was short in length and Gilly goes for the pull shot but mistimes it completely and has been caught in front of square-leg. Entertainment ends.
slower one but slips it down the leg side
drops it short this time. Blink. The ball has been picked up from the mid-wicket boundary
Over the sightscreen! Magnificent shot. He just knifed through the line.
Fabulicious wallop. Stylish hit over long-on. Lovely swing of the bat and the ball sails over the boundary
cut away to the off side
turns from outside, pushed towards cover
stays back to tuck it past square-leg
around the off stump line, chopped away
on the off-stump line, defended to the off side
turned out to midwicket
on the middle and off line, jabbed out to the bowler
full in length around off stump line, edged out to third man
fullish delivery, edged out to the off side
short in length on the middle stump line, tucked to square-leg
around 124 kmph short delivery and Laxman again goes for the pull but drags it straight to deep square-leg fielder. Hmm ... Cry of joy from the debutant.
drops it short and Lax has ample time to play the pull shot to perfection
length delivery just outside off stump, punched to mid-off
full in length and on the middle and leg line, Gilchrist plays his pick-up shot that he has played so well over the years.. one bounce to backward square-leg boundary
drops it short and Gilchrist goes for the pull and drags the ball through midwicket
short in length on the off and middle, pushed out to cover
Loverly hit over long-on. Gilly leaned forward to swing a length delivery from off stump line over long-on
on the off stump line, pushed towards mid-on for a single
Yet  another wide .. this time down the leg side.. Oh well..
dug in short and well outside off stump .. Laxman goes for the cut but doesn't reach
around off stump line this time, run down to third man
And again. Wide down the leg side
hint of swing but pushes it down the leg side
short in length, around off stump, straighter one, tries to push to cover and edges it to the on side
fuller, just outside off, on driven to long-on
quicker one, short in length, goes for the pull but again makes no contact .. the ball rolls of the pad
turns in to the middle stump line, stabbed to the on side
tries to turn it the on side but doesn't make contact
on the off stump line, pushed back to the bowler
